name: BlueVPN
description: Synchronize project metadata to version 2.0.0 and generate Android releases dynamically from 2.0.1 upward. Each successful GitHub Release increments the patch number instead of using a fixed version or the raw workflow run number.
version_strategy: Read latest GitHub Release. If it is v2.0.N, publish v2.0.(N+1); otherwise start at v2.0.1.
